decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=<pair 7:1><pair 3:1>, src=/reply-ep } - a two-element chain (RFC-0029 4.2). The first node dereferences 7:1 to the connection vertex of one of its point-to-point children, evaluates the op's right there (6.4), and egresses with dst shrunk by exactly the consumed element and src grown canonically by its inbound mount run (6.1).
decoded.note: The hop holds nothing: the pair IS its own vertex-index entry, so the deref is a bounds check, a generation compare and a registered test - no table, no descent, zero heap.
